from pathlib import Path
path = Path('src/data/lyrics/le-gaya-shimr-bete.md')
original = path.read_bytes()
header, roman_and_body = original.decode().split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
roman, body = roman_and_body.split('\\n---\\n', 1)
corrections = {
    ' may ': ' mein ',
    'fatema': 'Fatema',
    'lakhte jigar': 'lakht-e-jigar,',
    ' tin roz': ' tiin roz',
    'tiin roz': 'tin roz',
    'mehleka': 'mah laqa',
    'ek maa ki': 'ek maaṅ ki',
    'phayr': 'pher',
    'shimr': 'Shimr',
    'ek maa khun': 'ik maaṅ khun',
    'huwe': 'hue',
    'behaya': 'behaya',
    'ko pani': 'ko paani',
    'arz o samaa': 'arz o samaaṅ',
    'sayyeda': 'Sayyeda',
    'ro ke sarwar': 'ro ke Sarwar',
    'Amma pyasa hoo kehta raha ek pisar': 'Ammaaṅ pyasa huṅ, kehta raha ik pisar',
    'Jaa bajaa': 'Ja baja',
    'dukhiya udhar': 'dukhiya idhar',
    'pahunchade yasrab': 'pahuncha de Yasrab',
    'tanse sar ko juda': 'tan se sar so juda',
    'Godh': 'God',
    'Zulm aada': 'Zulm aadaa',
    'Laash uski': 'Laash us ki',
    'Ek qayaamt ka manzar wo rehan tha': 'Ik qayaamat ka manzar wo Rehan tha',
    'Kaise danish': 'Kaise Danish',
    'naize': 'neze',
}
for old, new in corrections.items():
    assert old in roman, old
    roman = roman.replace(old, new)
updated = (header + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + roman + '\\n---\\n' + body).encode()
assert updated.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
assert len(roman.splitlines()) == len(body.strip().splitlines()) == 47
path.write_bytes(updated)

item.text:
Audited all 51 Roman verse lines against the Urdu. Corrected nasal endings, spelling, and source mismatches, including `udhar` → `idhar` and `ko` → `so` where the Urdu reads سو.

Only `romanLyrics` was edited. The Urdu body and other metadata were preserved. The source wording `سر سو جدا` remains an editorial uncertainty.
